description: The CA certificate endpoint answers 200 with an application/x-pem-file body (a bare string schema), and the converter reads only application/json success bodies, so it came out with no output. Give it a string output: a sole raw `body` member, which the generator collapses to `string`; the REST protocol returns a non-JSON 2xx body as text. Source: the OpenAPI document served at https://api.clickhouse.cloud/v1 (2026-11-12).
